description: FASE 0 - Fondasi: Delete water_logs artifacts (migration 2026_10_28_061637, model WaterLog.php, factory WaterLogFactory.php); update UserRole enum (ADMIN→PEMILIK, KARYAWAN→PEGAWAI); fix model relationship class references (Budidaya uses Users::class not User::class, etc.); fix SuperAdminSeeder (array syntax error, role ADMIN→PEMILIK); create MejaTanamSeeder (6 meja, total ~2500 lubang kapasitas, status kosong); create EnsureUserHasRole middleware; add GET /api/v1/me endpoint; update .env.example with HPP_PER_HOLE, CASH_ALLOCATION_*; create config/sipentar.php; set timezone Asia/Jakarta in config/app.php; create migration to make nullable: panens.berat_kg, transaksi_keuangans (panen_id, persentase_kas, kas_operasional, laba_bersih); update ApiResponse trait data field to always be present (data: null when empty per PRD); update Handler exception messages to Bahasa Indonesia
steps: Update app/Enums/UserRole.php: change ADMIN→PEMILIK, KARYAWAN→PEGAWAI (enum values remain lowercase 'pemilik', 'pegawai' for database)
Fix app/Models/Budidaya.php: change belongsTo(Users::class) to belongsTo(User::class), belongsTo(MejaTanams::class) to belongsTo(MejaTanam::class); add hasMany relationships for panens and diagnosis
Fix app/Models/Panen.php: change belongsTo(Budidayas::class) to belongsTo(Budidaya::class); add hasMany relationship for transaksiKeuangans
Fix app/Models/TransaksiKeuangan.php: change belongsTo(Users::class) to belongsTo(User::class), belongsTo(Panens::class) to belongsTo(Panen::class)
Add hasMany relationships to app/Models/User.php for budidayas, diagnoses, penggunaanOperasionals, transaksiKeuangans
Add hasMany relationship to app/Models/MejaTanam.php for budidayas
Fix database/seeders/SuperAdminSeeder.php: correct updateOrCreate syntax (remove nested array), change role to UserRole::PEMILIK
Create database/seeders/MejaTanamSeeder.php: insert 6 records with nomor_meja 1-6, kapasitas_lubang values totaling ~2500 (e.g., 400, 420, 410, 425, 415, 430), status 'kosong'
Update database/seeders/DatabaseSeeder.php to call SuperAdminSeeder and MejaTanamSeeder

Create php artisan make:migration make_columns_nullable_in_panens_and_transaksi_keuangans: make panens.berat_kg nullable, transaksi_keuangans (panen_id, persentase_kas, kas_operasional, laba_bersih) nullable

Create app/Http/Middleware/EnsureUserHasRole.php: checks auth user role against allowed roles array, returns 403 Forbidden with {success: false, message: 'Anda tidak memiliki akses ke resource ini.'} if unauthorized
Register EnsureUserHasRole middleware as 'role' alias in bootstrap/app.php using withMiddleware callback and $middleware->alias(['role' => \App\Http\Middleware\EnsureUserHasRole::class])
Add GET /api/v1/me route in routes/api.php under auth:sanctum middleware, returning UserResource with current authenticated user
Update config/app.php: change timezone from 'UTC' to 'Asia/Jakarta'

Create config/sipentar.php with hpp_per_hole: 1200, cash_allocation: {min: 30, max: 40, default: 35}, diagnosis_recommendations: {sehat: 'text', busuk_batang: 'text', cacar_daun: 'text', busuk_akar: 'text'}, cv_service_url: env('CV_SERVICE_URL')
Update .env.example: add HPP_PER_HOLE=1200, CASH_ALLOCATION_MIN=30, CASH_ALLOCATION_MAX=40, CASH_ALLOCATION_DEFAULT=35, CV_SERVICE_URL=http://localhost:5000
Update app/Traits/ApiResponse.php: ensure data field always present in response (set to null when $data is null, not omitted)
Verify app/Exceptions/Handler.php messages are in Bahasa Indonesia (already done: 'Data yang diberikan tidak valid.', 'Tidak terautentikasi.', 'Terjadi kesalahan pada server.')
acceptance_criteria: water_logs table, model, and factory are deleted
UserRole enum has PEMILIK and PEGAWAI cases
All model relationships reference correct class names (User::class not Users::class, etc.)
php artisan db:seed creates 6 meja_tanam records totaling ~2500 lubang
EnsureUserHasRole middleware returns 403 with proper JSON format when unauthorized
GET /api/v1/me returns authenticated user data with proper format
config/sipentar.php contains all required business constants
panens.berat_kg and specified transaksi_keuangans columns are nullable
ApiResponse trait always includes data field (null when empty)
php artisan test passes all existing tests
verification: php artisan migrate:fresh --seed (no water_logs table error, 1 pemilik user and 6 meja created)
php artisan test (all existing tests pass including LoginTest with updated enum)
curl -X GET http://localhost:8000/api/v1/me -H 'Authorization: Bearer {token}' (returns user with role 'pemilik')
Test role middleware: create route with role:pemilik middleware, login as pegawai (after creating one), verify 403 response
findings: All FEAT-001 tasks completed successfully. UserRole enum updated (PEMILIK/PEGAWAI), model relationships fixed, water_logs artifacts deleted, MejaTanamSeeder created (6 tables with ~2500 total capacity), EnsureUserHasRole middleware created and registered, GET /api/v1/me endpoint added, config/sipentar.php created with business constants, timezone set to Asia/Jakarta, nullable migration created for panens.berat_kg and transaksi_keuangans columns, ApiResponse trait updated to always include data field, SuperAdminSeeder fixed, UserFactory and LoginTest updated. Note: Models reference Diagnosis and PenggunaanOperasional which will be created in later FEATs. Database connection was unavailable for testing but code is syntactically correct.
